label: Surface of revolution formula
section: From the sum to the integral
subgoals: Replace each curve chord by a cone frustum
Apply the mean value theorem to the chord length
Take the limit to S = 2pi times the integral of f times sqrt(1+(f')^2)

label: Slant correction
subgoals: Split dS into 2pi times r times ds
Read the radius r from the axis of revolution
Pick ds for a graph versus a parametric curve

label: Sphere check
subgoals: Differentiate sqrt(r^2-x^2) on the open interval
Cancel the radical against the ordinate to the constant r
Integrate the constant over [-r,r] to 4pi times r^2
